items.title: What Does General Motors (GM) Bringing Back Phone Integration Mean For Pickups?
items.summary: General Motors (NYSE:GM) plans to reintroduce built-in Apple CarPlay and Android Auto to the 2027 Silverado and Sierra pickup trucks. The automaker pairs the return of these smartphone systems with a redesigned in-vehicle interface focused on safety and driver usability. GM aims to blend vehicle data with familiar phone apps so drivers can access navigation, media, and diagnostics through a unified display. items.summary: It has been a successful first two weeks for  Apple’s  new CEO, John Ternus.
